prompts.C01:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single inventory charm icon for a Hollow Knight mod, one coherent collection. Hand-painted 2D insect-gothic talisman in the original Hollow Knight charm visual language: chunky irregular organic silhouette, thick near-black ink contour, bone-ivory highlights, muted charcoal/lavender shadows, simple flat cel shading, one restrained colored accent when relevant.
